subject.title: fix: allow bailian provider in resolveThinkingProfile

question: Should OpenClaw treat user-configured `bailian` Qwen `compat.thinkingFormat` rows as reasoning-capable in the generic configured-model inference path?
rationale: The code change is narrow, but it changes provider/model capability defaults for existing custom Bailian configs and the broader bundled Coding Plan issue remains a maintainer-owned support-boundary decision.

options.title: Accept Narrow Custom-Provider Inference
options.body: After the vLLM hook is removed and changed-path proof/tests are added, accept the generic configured-model inference slice while leaving bundled Coding Plan catalog work tracked separately.

options.title: Consolidate Into Qwen Provider Work
options.body: Pause this PR and require one provider-owned Qwen/Bailian Coding Plan change that aligns bundled catalog, custom-provider docs, tests, and vendor proof.

options.title: Defer Bailian Reasoning Defaults
options.body: Keep current conservative behavior until stronger model-by-model Alibaba proof justifies enabling reasoning for existing Bailian configs.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Custom-Provider Inference
recommendation.body: After the vLLM hook is removed and changed-path proof/tests are added, accept the generic configured-model inference slice while leaving bundled Coding Plan catalog work tracked separately.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the Qwen provider surface and has already routed the broader Bailian/Coding Plan support-boundary review.
